type: hub-defect / heavy-joint round — theory + light census, ledgers unchanged

s1_H_definition.hub_tax: max(w - 3, 0) per joint of weight w
s1_H_definition.H: sum of hub tax over all joints
s1_H_definition.which_joints: only joints (weight >= 2); rotations have weight 1 and contribute 0

s2_F0_structure.lemma: F = 0 forces every pass to be full (ell = 5), hence 120 entries one per hexagon, the free map is tau, and at k = 0 the 24 open orbits are saturated so G0 = 24 disjoint directed 5-cycles with c(G0) = 24 exactly
remaining_freedom: which 24 orbits (an exact cover of the 120 hexagons)
the entry phase of each block
the connector used between consecutive blocks

light_move_classification.W3b: cost 1, changes orbit — but NEVER USABLE at (0,0)
light_move_classification.W3c: cost 1, changes orbit — the unique light connector
light_move_classification.W3b_unusable_evidence: 720/720 words have orb(W3b) sharing a hexagon with orb(u); both would be distinct cover orbits, a contradiction

s3_s4_block_chain_theorem.scope: (k,F) = (0,0) AND r = 24 (equivalently S = 23, equivalently 96 free arcs)
s3_s4_block_chain_theorem.chain_map: D(u) = W3c(tau^4 u) — deterministic, because the only light connector is W3c and the block exit is forced to tau^4(u)
conclusion: each heavy connector has weight >= 4, hub tax >= 1, so H >= 5
s3_s4_block_chain_theorem.status: PROVED for this sub-case (exhaustive over all 720 starting words)

s11_positive_control_greedy873.note: the bound H >= 5 is ATTAINED: exactly 6 chains of exactly 4 blocks and exactly 5 heavy connectors; the walk's H = 6 because one heavy joint has weight 5

remaining_gap_at_00.why: for r >= 25 some orbit is split into several runs, so a run's exit entry is no longer forced to tau^4(entry); the light-chain map stops being deterministic and the branching factor rises to 5

over_approximation_fails.model: allow the run to exit at any phase of its orbit
over_approximation_fails.verdict: useless — erasing the phase correlation destroys the bound, exactly the failure mode anticipated in the round brief; a finer state such as (orbit, entry phase, exit phase) is required

s15_falsification.B_orbit_phase_geometry: the over-approximated model admits chains of length >= 24, so it is not a valid witness class — it over-allows
s15_falsification.C_genuine_NR6_walks: none found; greedy 873 satisfies the proved bound with equality

disclaimer: This project has not proved L6 >= 872. NR6 remains a separate assumption.
